title: Director of AI Operations
raw_text: Prairie Sky Energy is a mid-size upstream oil and gas operator based in Calgary. We are hiring a Director of AI Operations to lead our AI and automation program across field operations, finance, and back-office functions. This is a deployment and operations role, not a research or model-building role -- you will select, implement, and run AI tools inside our existing organization, not build or train models. Responsibilities: partner with operations and finance leadership to identify high-value automation opportunities; own vendor selection and cost/ROI analysis for AI tooling (build vs. buy, API vs. hosted model economics); establish governance, review, and approval processes so AI-assisted workflows stay auditable and under control; manage a small team supporting rollout across multiple business units; report progress and risk directly to the executive team. Requirements: 5+ years leading operations, transformation, or automation initiatives, ideally in energy, industrial, or another asset-heavy sector; hands-on experience deploying AI/LLM tools inside a real business (not academic or personal projects); comfort with financial modeling and cost analysis for technology decisions; strong stakeholder management across operations and finance; based in or willing to relocate to Calgary. No software engineering, data science, or machine learning degree required -- this role is about running AI in production, not building it. Compensation $150,000-$180,000 base depending on experience, plus benefits.
